redesignateToPflpPage.title: WELSH - Apply for designation as a private fund limited partnership (PFLP)
redesignateToPflpPage.introduction1: WELSH - A limited partnership can be designated as a PFLP if it is constituted by an agreement in writing and is a collective investment scheme.
redesignateToPflpPage.introduction2: WELSH - Once the designation has been made, the type of partnership cannot be changed again.
redesignateToPflpPage.pflpMeaningsIntro: WELSH - Becoming a PFLP means that:

pflpMeanings.capital: WELSH - imited partners will no longer be required to contribute capital
pflpMeanings.appoint: WELSH - Limited partners can appoint a person to wind up the partnership if there is no general partner available to do so
pflpMeanings.agreement: WELSH - Partners can make an agreement about winding up the partnership
pflpMeanings.risk: WELSH - Limited partners may take more actions without risking losing their limited liability status
pflpMeanings.admin: WELSH - Some administrative requirements will be removed
pflpMeanings.scheme: WELSH - The partnership will no longer qualify as a ‘partnership scheme’, and therefore cannot be an authorised contractual scheme under section 235A(6)(aa) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000

redesignateToPflpPage.information: WELSH - Find more information in the
redesignateToPflpPage.informationLink: WELSH - Legislative Reform (Private Fund Limited Partnerships) Order 2017
redesignateToPflpPage.cost: WELSH - It costs £{{ cost }} to apply.
redesignateToPflpPage.applicationCheck: WELSH - I/We apply for this firm to be designated as a private fund limited partnership. For that purpose, I confirm that the partnership is constituted by an agreement in writing and is a collective investment scheme within the meaning of section 8D(4) of the Limited Partnerships Act 1907
redesignateToPflpPage.confirmationCheck: WELSH - I confirm that all general partners have agreed for this application to be made

termPage.title: WELSH - What is the term of the partnership?
termPage.hint: WELSH - This is the length of time for which the partnership will be entered into.
termPage.byAgreement: WELSH - Such term as decided by the partners within the partnership agreement
termPage.untilDissolution: WELSH - Until a general partner determines the partnership is dissolved
termPage.publicRegisterLine1: WELSH - We'll show the term of partnership on the public register.

whereIsTheJurisdiction.title: WELSH - Where is the jurisdiction?
whereIsTheJurisdiction.hint: WELSH - This is where the partnership was formed. The registered office address and principal place of business will need to be in the same jurisdiction.

scotland.title: WELSH - The partnership will be registered in Scotland
scotland.information: WELSH - The partnership's registered office address must be in Scotland. The principal place of business must be in Scotland at registration.
scotland.ifNotScotland: WELSH - If the partnership's addresses are in England, Wales or Northern Ireland, you'll need to go back to change the type of partnership you are registering.
